hints.title: Divisor Parity Toggle Analysis
hints.text: A bulb at position k is toggled once for every divisor of k. It ends in the on state if and only if it has an odd number of divisors.

hints.title: Perfect Square Odd Factor Property
hints.text: Divisors pair up in factors (d, k/d). A number has an odd number of divisors if and only if it is a perfect square.

hints.title: Square Root Floor Calculation
hints.text: The number of bulbs remaining on is simply the number of perfect squares less than or equal to n, which equals floor(sqrt(n)).

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(1) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating n rounds of bulb toggles takes O(N^2) time and causes timeouts when n reaches 10^9.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Direct mathematical reduction evaluates the square root in strictly O(1) time and memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that only perfect squares possess odd divisor multiplicities.
